what_it_is: Tonbo Imaging is a Bengaluru-based defence-electro-optics company building thermal imaging and EO/IR systems for land, air and naval platforms - from weapon sights and driver vision enhancers to missile-seeker-class infrared engines and counter-UAS sensing. The company operates as a full-stack OEM of imaging sensors and fuzing, with exports to multiple allied militaries alongside its Indian base.
india_angle: Tonbo is among India's most capitalised private defence-tech firms: it reported a pre-IPO round of about Rs 1.75 billion (~$20M) in 2025 and has public IPO plans on Indian exchanges. Its sensors are widely referenced on Indian Armoured Corps and infantry modernisation programmes, giving it one of the strongest verified India footprints in the atlas's EO/IR segment.
intelligence_assessment: Tonbo's funding trail and IPO filings give unusually verifiable corporate evidence; specific Indian order quantities and platform-level integrations are less public. Watch the DRDO/armed-force supply announcements and the IPO prospectus for audited order-book detail - the single best forthcoming source on its India portfolio.

Bengaluru, India, with international subsidiaries serving export customers.
